prompt: Build a single-page marketing site for 'Driftwood', a small-batch surfboard shaper in Ventura, CA. He hand-shapes maybe 40 boards a year and has a 6-month waitlist. Single index.html with embedded CSS is fine. Make it feel like him, not like a startup.
assertions: No generic fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Poppins, Space Grotesk) used as the display/body face
No cream/warm off-white background family and no terracotta/coral accent family
Mobile responsive (media queries and/or fluid clamp() sizing present)
Context-specific content (shaper/waitlist/Ventura details), not interchangeable startup copy
